fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi FDA introducing 20-business-day process for rare disease new drug classification to streamline regulatory pathway.
fields.summary_ko.1: Singapore Health Authority and Saudi FDA signed memorandum of understanding on September 14 to strengthen collaboration on new drug and biotech development and registration pathways.
fields.summary_ko.2: Saudi CDMO Refera signed MOUs with Pfizer, Sanofi, MSD and others, accelerating regional biotech ecosystem growth.
